name: HANSOM
author: optim-agent
description:
Taxicab TSP with a threshold. Clue is 'x,y x,y ...|B': 5-7 distinct lattice points and a
bound B. A solution is a permutation of the point indices (0-based, space separated); the
closed tour visiting them in that order, measured in MANHATTAN distance, must be <= B.
B = optimal + 0/0/1/2 (random), so some seeds accept a merely-good tour and some demand the
optimum. DIFFICULTY: medium.
DISCOVERY PATH: a hansom is a *cab* => taxicab metric. The demo shows a permutation of
0..n-1, so the answer shape is obvious; the open questions are (a) closed vs open tour and
(b) which metric. Euclidean-minimising tours are usually also Manhattan-good, so teams get
partial credit early (nice gradient) and must tighten later. Scorer pulls every integer out
of clue and solution with re.findall, so junk can never raise.
